scope: MSFT (Q1 FY2027), GOOGL and AMZN (Q3 2026): the quarter ended 2026-09-30, from each company's 10-Q XBRL and its Item 2.02 earnings-release (8-K EX-99.1) tables. Additive only.

eligibility_check.rule: press-release ingestion pairs each earnings 8-K with its filed 10-Q (or 10-K for a fiscal Q4)

not_added.AAPL: no new Item 2.02 8-K and no FY2026 10-K on EDGAR

eligibility_check.note: Fetched into an isolated scratch cache, so the shared EDGAR cache for these companies was not changed.

command_notes: SEC_USER_AGENT was supplied in each command's environment; its value is not recorded.
The snapshot was built with scripts/build_snapshot.py from frozen_code_commit, over the topped-up data/.
press_release --validate rewrites data/pr_facts/_validation.json; the earlier file was restored byte for byte and this run's report is kept below under gates.2_press_release_validation.

ingest_window.why_quarters_8: A dry rebuild from the pre-refresh cached inputs with this window reproduced every stored MSFT, GOOGL and AMZN row exactly (0 missing, 0 extra). --quarters 9 would also have added older history: +40/+35/+37 facts and +2/+4/+3 filings (Q2 2023 and Microsoft's FY2023).

sec_requests.detail: ingest: MSFT and AMZN Submissions + companyfacts, GOOGL Submissions + page 001 + companyfacts (company_tickers.json from cache); dry run: three filing indexes and three EX-99.1 exhibits; the mapping run read all 15 inputs from the cache. Amazon's EX-99.2 (4,342 bytes) was skipped by the secondary-exhibit size rule without a request.

model.budget_note: --budget-usd caps the cumulative press-release ledger, not one run: 3.31 = 2.412138 already spent + 0.897862. With --concurrency 1 at most one call's estimate error can land past the cap, so new spend could not exceed $1.00.
model.price_check: dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits on 2026-10-30: muse-spark-1.3 Standard $1.25 input, $0.15 cached input, $4.25 output per 1M tokens, matching receipts.press_release.PRICE_PER_M.

canonical_row_hashes.method: sha256 over the newline-joined, sorted rows of each table, each row serialised as json.dumps(list(row)) with every column except facts.id (an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY that replace_company reassigns on re-insert); old rows are checked as a multiset contained in the new rows. press-release files: sha256 per file.

1_canonical_row_hashes.detail: see canonical_row_hashes; re-hashed after the snapshot rebuild with no difference

3_dev_replay.compared: claim id, value text, span start, status, reason and explanation
3_dev_replay.note: Recorded with the frozen commit's code as code root (other agents were editing receipts/ in the working tree), and again with the working tree; both equal the baseline byte for byte.

6_pytest.isolated_tree: frozen commit + eval/qa_reproduce.py, tests/test_qa_reproduce.py, eval/qa_methods.md and the evidence archive, over the topped-up data: 1581 passed
6_pytest.working_tree: two runs first failed collection in 15 modules on another agent's in-progress receipts/api.py and ask_api.py (create_router() got an unexpected keyword argument 'filing_quota'); after its fix: 1587 passed

7_probes.deviation: The gate expected ? one second before acceptance; all 6 claims return ✗ wrong / look_ahead there instead, citing the 8-K.
7_probes.method: typed claims built the way extraction delivers them, verified with receipts.verify against the rebuilt snapshot; no model, network or SEC call
7_probes.note: One second before each 8-K's acceptance the result is ✗ look_ahead, not ?: the release's own press-release fact dates the figure, so the verifier reports that it wasn't public yet. Tesla's XBRL-only probe returned ? because its earlier 8-K had no stored figure. Before this top-up the same claims at Now returned ? no_evidence.

qa_reproduce_archive.source: pre-top-up data/snapshot/facts.sqlite from the backup taken before any change
qa_reproduce_archive.rule: eval/qa_reproduce.py reads a pinned snapshot file from data/snapshot while its digest equals the pin; when it differs or is missing, it reads only the same-named file under the run's evidence/ folder, checks it against the same pin, and fails with a clear error if that copy is missing or different.

limitations: JPM, BAC and AAPL were not topped up: their Q3 (AAPL: FY2026 Q4) periodic reports were not on EDGAR when checked.
AMD and NVDA have not reported a newer quarter; their windows still end with the June/July 2026 quarter.
The XBRL window is computed from the run date; re-running the ingest weeks later shifts it.
Press-release facts come from Muse Spark table maps that code re-parses; the 88 + 13 GAAP comparisons validate integration, not segment or non-GAAP figures, which have no XBRL counterpart.
Probes test store and verifier integration, not independent extraction accuracy.
